beats.anchor: « Regardez ! Je suis un bonhomme de neige ! »
beats.extras: Mrs. Hayes (about 70): a round, cheerful Black American woman with short grey curls and a big laugh, in a thick padded coat over a red cardigan, holding a warm sweet potato pie in a dish. Mr. Hayes (about 75): a very tall, thin, quiet white-haired Black American man in a heavy brown work jacket and a wool cap. Biscuit, their dog: a low, long-bodied hound with immense floppy ears, jumping happily in the snow.
beats.outfit: BriBri still in his pyjamas and flip-flops, his red sock on his RIGHT foot and his yellow sock on his LEFT foot, small soft round afro full of snowflakes. Kaydoudou in his brand-new red anorak, too shiny, thin shaved part on the left side of his head.
beats.action: BriBri has just slipped while trying the snow shovel: he lies flat on his back in the fresh snow, arms and legs spread, the shovel beside him, laughing up at the sky. Biscuit bounces on him with flapping ears. Mrs. Hayes laughs so hard she has to hold her pie with both hands. Mr. Hayes looks down with a tiny smile. Kaydoudou, standing in the snow, shakes his head with a dry, amused smile.
beats.location: The snowy front yard of a small beige house in Waldorf, Maryland, a street of similar beige houses, a mailbox on a post, a basketball hoop with a frozen net at the end of the driveway.
beats.light: Midday winter light, white low sky, soft cool shadows, snow sparkling.
beats.camera: Medium shot from slightly above, BriBri spread in the snow at the bottom of the frame, the adults and Kaydoudou standing around him.
beats.alt: BriBri, en pyjama, glisse avec la pelle et tombe dans la neige ; Biscuit lui saute dessus et Mrs. Hayes rit en tenant sa tarte.

beats.anchor: Quand le ballon frôle l'ampoule, elle se balance, et leurs ombres dansent sur les murs.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou at home in a plain forest-green T-shirt and jeans, thin shaved part on the left side of his head. BriBri in his sun-yellow T-shirt with one vertical red stripe on the left side of the chest, green shorts, no shoes, his red sock on his RIGHT foot and his yellow sock on his LEFT foot, small soft round afro. Mami's ball: an old, slightly misshapen light-brown leather ball with a square of red and yellow wax-print cloth hand-stitched on it with big stitches, three small marker signatures beside the patch, not readable.
beats.action: In the basement, Kaydoudou has just headed Mami's ball upward. The ball has brushed the bare light bulb, which swings on its wire. BriBri waits underneath on his tiptoes, arms out for balance, ready to catch it on his thigh. Their two big shadows dance and swing across the cement walls.
beats.location: The basement of the beige house in Waldorf: cement floor, a washing machine, a big round boiler, pipes along the ceiling, a small round mark on the ceiling where the ball keeps hitting, wooden stairs going up.
beats.light: Warm light from a single bare bulb swinging on its wire, moving shadows, cold blue night at a tiny window high in the wall.
beats.camera: Quiet medium wide shot from a corner near the stairs, the swinging bulb at the top centre, the brothers and their huge shadows below.
beats.alt: Au sous-sol, les frères jonglent avec le ballon de Mami ; l'ampoule nue se balance et leurs ombres dansent sur les murs.

beats.anchor: Le ballon touche son pied et repart aussitôt. Une seule touche.
beats.extras: Diego Ramírez (11): a small wiry Salvadoran-American boy with light brown skin, short black hair spiked with gel and a big chatty grin, in a plain white T-shirt and black shorts, calling for the ball on the left. A boy in a plain grey T-shirt (11): sturdy, pale skin, short brown hair, lunging toward Kaydoudou too late. In the far background, on a bench, Papa Armand. Other kids in plain T-shirts, blurred.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his faded forest-green football shirt with white collar and white number 8, thin shaved part on the left side of his head, black shorts, white socks. BriBri in his sun-yellow T-shirt with one vertical red stripe on the left side of the chest, green shorts, his red sock on his RIGHT foot and his yellow sock on his LEFT foot, small soft round afro, already running toward the goal. Papa Armand, tall, short neat beard, in a winter jacket, holding his knitted green, red and yellow beanie in his hand. A small, heavy futsal ball.
beats.action: Slow motion on the third ball. Kaydoudou does not look at the ball: his head is already up, eyes on Diego, and the ball leaves his foot in one single touch toward the left, a split second before the boy in grey arrives with his leg stretched out. Diego opens his body to receive. BriBri is already darting toward the small goal.
beats.location: An indoor community centre gym in winter: a shiny wooden floor with coloured lines, two small futsal goals, a drinks machine in the corner, tall windows with snow falling outside.
beats.light: Cool white gym lights, reflections on the wooden floor, grey snowy daylight in the windows.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle at floor level behind the boy in grey, Kaydoudou in the centre, the passing line toward Diego on the left, BriBri running on the right.
beats.alt: Au futsal, Kaydoudou a déjà décidé : il joue en une seule touche vers Diego, juste avant que le garçon en gris arrive.
